name: Alligator Lizard

review.observation: Full original: squared scale rows and dark rectangular cross-bands, elongated trunk, long continuous tail and short bent legs. Three feet are clearly readable; far hindfoot/leg is not independently established. HOLD for unresolved fourth limb. Flank fold reads as a dark lateral line rather than a confidently distinct skin fold. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
